title: State Filing Desk Card — Correction Rate by Rejection History (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
For a corrected refiling of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the correction rate depends on the rejections on the filing's record and on which transmission the state rejected.

**Definitions.**
- *Rejections on record:* the state responses on the filing's record other than acknowledgments — every response carrying a rejection code, whenever it was received.
- *Rejected transmission:* the latest transmission on the filing's record.

| Rejections on record | Rejected transmission | Correction rate |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | Any | 20.00 |
| Exactly one | The original certificate — the state holds no certificate for the driver at all | 10.00 |
| Exactly one | A later transmission, such as an amendment, while the earlier certificate stays on the state's file | The certificate's refiling fee after rejection |

**Hypothetical readings.**
- The original certificate was rejected once for a license number mismatch and nothing has been sent since: one rejection, original certificate, 10.00.
- An accepted certificate was later amended, and the amendment was rejected for a policy number format code: one rejection, later transmission, the certificate's refiling fee after rejection.
- The original certificate was rejected, corrected, and the corrected certificate was rejected again: two rejections, 20.00.
